meta.title: Vararedo: your plan for a crisis
meta.description: Answer a few simple questions and get a personal plan for how your household can handle a crisis.

common.answerRequired: Choose an answer here to continue.
common.fixErrors: A question is missing an answer. It is marked in red.
common.startOverConfirm: All your answers will be deleted. Do you want to start over?

landing.title: Could your household manage a week without electricity or water?
landing.lead: Answer a few simple questions about your home. You get a plan made for your household: what you need to have at home and what to do first.
landing.ctaNote: Takes about 5 minutes. Free. You do not need to log in.

how.title: Answer questions
how.text: About your home, who lives there and what you already have.

how.title: Get your plan
how.text: A list of what you are missing and what to do if something happens.

how.title: Do one thing at a time
how.text: Tick things off and print the plan. Put it up on the fridge.

landing.whyTitle: Why a plan of your own?
landing.whyText: The authorities give the same advice to everyone. But a family with a baby, an older person living alone in the countryside and a student need different things. The plan is based on your household.

footer.disclaimer: Vararedo is a complement to information from the authorities, not a replacement. Always follow advice from the authorities and your municipality.
footer.source: The advice is based on information from the Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency (MCF).

power_outage.title: Long power outage
power_outage.text: No electricity for several days. Heating, elevators and water may stop working.

it_payment_mobile.title: Payments and mobile do not work
it_payment_mobile.text: Cards, Swish and the mobile network may be down.

water_outage.title: No water from the tap
water_outage.text: The water may stop running or become unsafe to drink.

extreme_weather.title: Severe weather
extreme_weather.text: Storm, flooding, heatwave or forest fire.

war_heightened.title: War or heightened alert
war_heightened.text: Sweden could end up in war or on heightened alert.

address.label: Your address

needs.label: Does any of this apply to someone in the household?

freeText.label: Tell us about anything in your household that we have not asked about.
freeText.hint: For example, something that would make a crisis harder for you. Do not write diagnoses or names.
